name: Lyon laboratory scientist approaching contract end

context.seniority: Experienced laboratory practitioner; exact degree unspecified
context.geography: Lyon; considering Geneva, Lausanne and Basel
constraints: Cannot assume German fluency or Swiss eligibility
context.company_awareness: Knows several large pharma employers; smaller biotech companies less familiar

trigger: The laboratory confirms that the current fixed-term appointment will not be extended, leaving a limited window to find the next role and plan a move.

searches_run.query: emploi laboratoire biotechnologie Genève Lausanne Bâle
searches_run.observation: Results mixed hospital diagnostics, biotech laboratory work, academic openings and aggregators. Several different job families appeared under a broad laboratory label; a retrieved CHUV result had a past application deadline.

searches_run.query: laboratory scientist Basel cell culture English relocation French
searches_run.observation: Results included Novartis, Roche and University of Basel roles. The opened Novartis posting explicitly requires English, treats German as advantageous and rules out relocation support for that vacancy.

sources.title: Technicien-ne en analyses biomédicales — CHUV
sources.supports: Retrieved employer result identifies a Lausanne diagnostic laboratory role and an August 2026 deadline, demonstrating that retrievable pages need not still accept applications.

sources.title: Technicien de laboratoire, biologie moléculaire — Adaptyv
sources.supports: Retrieved aggregator snippet lists PCR, cloning and protein-related skills for on-site Lausanne work. Not directly verified against the employer.

sources.title: USP Research Scientist II — Novartis
sources.supports: Directly inspected employer page states on-site Basel work, mammalian cell-culture expertise, English essential/German advantageous, and no relocation support for this role. A French site wrapper contains English job text.

best_entry_page.primary_query: emploi laboratoire biotech Suisse français anglais
best_entry_page.promise: Search Swiss laboratory roles across French and English titles, then compare published methods, language requirements and relocation information.
best_entry_page.cta: Save separate searches for suitable laboratory work in each target city.
proof_needed: Show current source postings and distinguish research from regulated diagnostic roles.
Demonstrate laboratory-method coverage; software technology filters alone are insufficient proof.
Distinguish page language, job language and required working languages.
Use role-specific relocation wording, including explicit absence and unknown.
Create a new indexable acquisition guide; live search is currently noindex.

conversion_objections: Will laboratory techniques be recognised rather than only software skills?
Will a French-only search hide relevant English postings?
Are these openings still accepting applications?
Is relocation support real for this role?
Can I compare contract duration and expected start date?

avoid_targeting.reason: Credential and eligibility outcomes cannot be promised.
Conflicts with the skilled laboratory need.
Employer support varies by vacancy; no guarantee is demonstrated.

message_to_founder: Simulation: Mon CDD se termine et je dois choisir où concentrer mes candidatures. Je veux retrouver mes techniques de laboratoire dans les annonces, même quand le titre est anglais, puis savoir ce qui est écrit sur la langue de travail et le déménagement.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic bilingual journey. Two queries and one direct inspection provide examples, not a census of Swiss hiring. Exact technical repertoire, degree and notice period are unknown; cell culture and PCR are exploratory search examples, not asserted qualifications.
